#define rep(i,a,b) for (int i=(a);i<=(b);i++)
#define repd(i,a,b) for (int i=(a);i>=(b);i--)
typedef long long LL;
const int P=1000000007;
int tot,p,k,len;
bool vis[1000020];

LL power(LL a,int n) {
    LL t=1;
    for (;n;n>>=1) {
        if (n&1) t=(t*a)%P;
        a=(a*a)%P;
    }
    return t;
}

int main() {
    cin>>p>>k;
    if (k==0) {
        cout<<power(p,p-1)<<endl;
        return 0;
    }
    if (k==1) {
        cout<<power(p,p)<<endl;
        return 0;
    }
    vis[1]=true;
    len=1;
    for (LL i=k;!vis[i];vis[i]=true,i=(i*k)%p,len++);
    tot=(p-1)/len;
    cout<<power(p,tot)<<endl;
    return 0;
}
